_comment: All durationSeconds are BASE forge times, before speed reductions. Quick Forge (Heart of the Mountain) can reduce forge time by 20% at an applicable perk level, and Mayor Cole’s Molten Forge perk can reduce it by an ADDITIONAL 25 percentage points for processes started during his term. These bonuses stack ADDITIVELY: with 20% Quick Forge and Cole, effective time = base * 0.55. The current wiki lists Quick Forge reductions up to 30%. Other effects, such as the Gemstone Gauntlet Kinetic ability, are not included here.

source.notes: 119 Forge entries checked against the wiki index; legacy recipes are only partially audited. Direct ingredients, not expanded material trees.

timeModifiers.coleAppliesTo: Processes started after the beginning of his term

verificationLegend.wiki_checked: Ingredients, base forge time and unlock were read from the current community wiki/index or individual item page. Still worth in-game testing.
verificationLegend.wiki_audited: Previously uploaded entry patched using confirmed wiki discrepancies and selected current fields; not a guarantee of exhaustive field verification.
verificationLegend.legacy_partial_audit: Carried over from snapshot; no full current wiki comparison yet.
verificationLegend.partial_wiki: Ingredients and prerequisites wiki-checked; one or more important fields are unknown.
